title: Reading a differential equation
summary: Understand what you are solving for, what a derivative means, and what an initial condition adds.

title: Separable equations
summary: Separate the two variables, integrate, and recover the constant solutions that division can hide.

title: First-order linear equations
summary: Turn the left side into one product derivative using an integrating factor.

title: Exact equations
summary: Recognize a hidden total derivative and reconstruct its potential function.

title: Substitutions: homogeneous and Bernoulli
summary: Replace a difficult expression with a new variable so a familiar method becomes available.

title: Growth, cooling, and mixing
summary: Translate a short word problem into a rate equation with consistent units.

title: Linear theory and reduction of order
summary: Understand why solutions combine, and find a second solution when one is already known.

title: Constant coefficients and characteristic roots
summary: Turn differentiation into a polynomial, then translate its roots into real solutions.

title: Undetermined coefficients and resonance
summary: Choose a trial particular solution and determine its coefficients by substitution.

title: Variation of parameters
summary: Use a general method when a simple trial function will not work.

title: Cauchy–Euler equations
summary: Use powers of x for equations whose coefficients match the derivative order.

title: Springs, damping, and circuits
summary: Build a second-order model and connect the solution to physical behaviour.

title: Power series essentials
summary: Read sigma notation, differentiate a series, and line up powers before comparing coefficients.

title: Solving with a power series
summary: Turn a differential equation into a recurrence that builds the solution one coefficient at a time.

title: The Laplace transform
summary: Understand the transform as a new representation of a function and learn the core transform pairs.

title: Inverse transforms and initial-value problems
summary: Use algebra and partial fractions to recover a time-domain solution.

title: Shifts, switches, and piecewise inputs
summary: Distinguish exponential shifts from time delays and write switched inputs correctly.

title: Convolution and transform operations
summary: Recognize products of transforms and handle time factors without starting a new integral from scratch.

title: Impulse inputs and the Dirac delta
summary: Model a short kick and understand the jump it causes.

title: Linear systems and eigenvectors
summary: Solve coupled equations by identifying independent directions of motion.

title: Nonhomogeneous systems
summary: Combine the system’s natural modes with a response to external forcing.
